messages:
anna_dev: Heads-up — after kernel autoselect landed on staging, tail latency (p99) for the TRT/vLLM route jumped ~30%. I kicked off nsys traces and a couple of perfetto captures. (2143210987)
perfbot: automated trace started: nsys profile --stats true --output trace_autoselect_2143210987.nsys --sample=none --trace=cuda,cudnn,osrt ./run_inference.sh :eyes:
miguel_s: quick skim of the nsys summary — big memcpy HtoD bursts around the wrapper/engine boundary. timeline shows long gaps where GPU is idle waiting on host copies. snippet: 
```
GPU Activities: memcpy HtoD 41.8% | trt::enqueue 17.9% | cudaStreamSynchronize 22.3% | other kernels 18.0%
CPU Activities: vllm_wrapper_dispatch loop busywait 28% | scheduler spinlock 15% | host memcpy 26%
```
sofia_p: exact stack: wrapper does `cudaMemcpyAsync(kv_tile, host_buf)` then immediate `cudaStreamSynchronize` on that stream to guarantee KV ready before enqueue. autoselect changed kernel layout so enqueue path now uses a different stream, forcing syncs.
anna_dev: ohhh. autoselect picked a smaller tile kernel variant that requires host-side tiling; that increased H2D freq. previous kernel variant used device-side copy and fused ops.
miguel_s: here's the relevant wrapper pseudocode I extracted: 
```cpp
// vllm wrapper
for (batch : batches) {
  prepare_host_tile(batch);
  cudaMemcpyAsync(dev_tile, host_tile, ..., streamA);
  // old flow: enqueue on streamA (no sync)
  // new autoselect: enqueue uses streamB => we sync
  cudaStreamSynchronize(streamA);
  trt_engine.enqueue(streamB, ...);
}
```
sofia_p: the sync forces host idle and serializes batches, removing inter-batch overlap. that matches the idle gaps in GPU timeline.
miguel_s: NVTX regions show that the `kernel_autoselect()` decision runs per batch (~1.2ms) and sometimes chooses the small-tile kernel for short sequences; but small-tile ends up causing extra host copies.
anna_dev: repro plan: 1) run nsys with env TR_AUTOSELECT_DEBUG=1 to log per-batch choice; 2) run with TR_DISABLE_AUTSELECT=1 to compare; 3) try fused copy+enqueue path (prototype patch)
opsbot: allocated job infra: tracer VMs up, 4 GPU nodes reserved until 2143212000.
miguel_s: quick diff from no-autoselect run: memcpy HtoD drops 40%, cudaStreamSynchronize time drops 18%, overall p99 back to baseline. seems autoselect is root cause.
sofia_p: short-term mitigation: patch wrapper to use same stream for copy+enqueue when kernels are compatible. also add KV prefetch to avoid host copies for small sequences.
anna_dev: opened issue #INF-6234 with logs + nsys tarball, assigned to @sofia_p and @miguel_s. adding test that asserts no new syncs introduced by autoselect change.
sofia_p: I'll land a defensive guard: if autoselect picks a kernel that changes stream affinity, fallback to the previous fused kernel for low-latency paths. patch coming in a PR.
miguel_s: note for postmortem: we should add an nsys CI sample for the wrapper boundary (10k inferences, mixed lengths) to catch regressions.
anna_dev: thanks — great triage. keeping this thread as the single source. will follow up with perf numbers after the patch. :thumbsup:
